facts.text: Caroline mentors a transgender teen and has been working on building confidence and finding positive strategies with them.

evidence.quote: I mentor a transgender teen just like me. We've been working on building up confidence and finding positive strategies, and it's really been paying off!
I've met some amazing young folks and supported them along the way. It's inspiring to see how resilient and strong they are.

facts.text: Caroline and her mentee attended an LGBT pride event last month, which was described as a positive and encouraging experience.

evidence.quote: We had a great time at the LGBT pride event last month.
The pride event was awesome! It was so encouraging to be surrounded by so much love and acceptance.

facts.text: Caroline shared an image of a woman holding a rainbow umbrella in the air, which was taken at the LGBT pride event.

evidence.quote: [image: a photo of a woman holding a rainbow umbrella in the air]

facts.text: Caroline described a moment where her mentee's face lit up upon seeing the support, which she considered a special and memorable experience.

evidence.quote: Seeing my mentee's face light up when they saw the support was the best! Such a special moment.
